items.title: Norman Brownlee Interview, 1961-05-05
items.q: we came on home I think from 9.30 on Johnny Byersdorfer and his gang played after that I think uh if I'm not mistaken Johnny Byersdorfer let's see who Johnny had with him then

ctx.x: yeah I used to swing it that's yeah I all I quit playing string bass when I got to the part where I couldn't dance with it anymore on account of my bad leg and and I say if you can't dance with it don't play it that is string bass I used to really swing it around what about Winging Manon Winging Manon Winging Manon was a character we we we Shanghai'd Winging one time he was going up Canal Street with his horn under his arm and he had just gone in Grunewald Music Store to buy some uh silver some uh silver polish…
